Red Dog was a member of The Renegades, a team that Sgt. Slaughter commanded. Little background is given on him, except that he was booted out of pro-football for unnecessary roughness.

page.overview:
Who is Red Dog?

Red Dog was a member of The Renegades, a team that Sgt. Slaughter commanded. Little background is given on him, except that he was booted out of pro-football for unnecessary roughness.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

Red Dog was first released in a special three-pack along with Mercer and Taurus for the 1987 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: black curly hair; gold headband, tooth necklace, and wristbands; red sport shirt with "1" on front; white short sleeves; blue pants with brown belt and holster; black boots

Accessories: reddish brown "Dusty" backpack; dark grey .45 caliber pistol with long hammer and trigger some distance from grip. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/reddog.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/reddog.shtml Filecard]
